description: Takes one flow off a conversation, as the flow chip's Remove does; its open step tasks are removed. conversationFlowId names the flow. reason is optional. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: remove_conversation_flow
title: Remove a flow from a conversation
